off-t37.description: Internal partnership procurement policy defining allowable resiliency pairings, budget cap, and installation restrictions handling.
canonical_facts: Document title: 'Regional Office Internet Resiliency Partnership Policy 2025'
Policy section states all recommendations for partnership requests must include two independent access paths or a documented exception
Policy section states monthly recurring spend cap for request REQ-PART-31044 under customer CUS-6678 is $3600
Policy section states one-time installation spend cap is $5000 total
Policy section states rooftop-mounted radio, dish, or antenna installations are prohibited at leased sites unless explicit landlord roof permit is shown
Policy section states if building materials prohibit exterior core drilling, vendors requiring a new exterior wall penetration are non-compliant
Policy section states preferred demarcation point for this office class is basement telecom/MPOE where available
Policy section states for partnership reviews the selected bundle must be routed through owner group 'Network Procurement Review'
Policy appendix references review record family INC-NET-31044 for the active request
Policy notes instruct creation of a follow-up incident for the next compliant implementation step after bundle selection
Policy includes a nearby archived example referencing INC-NET-31014 as a distractor
off-t37.generation_prompt: Render a 4-page internal policy PDF titled 'Regional Office Internet Resiliency Partnership Policy 2025'. Use a formal enterprise policy style with section numbering, headers, and an approval footer. Include explicit, machine-readable policy clauses: (1) partnership requests require two independent access paths unless a documented exception exists; (2) for REQ-PART-31044 / customer CUS-6678 the MRC cap is $3,600 and total one-time install cap is $5,000; (3) rooftop-mounted radios, dishes, or antennas are prohibited at leased sites unless explicit landlord roof permit is shown; (4) if building materials or landlord restrictions prohibit exterior core drilling, any vendor requiring a new exterior wall penetration is non-compliant; (5) preferred demarcation is basement telecom/MPOE where available; (6) active partnership review should be routed to owner group 'Network Procurement Review'; (7) after selecting a compliant bundle, create a follow-up incident for the next compliant implementation step. Include an appendix with an archived sample reference to INC-NET-31014 to introduce a nearby distractor, but make the active instructions clearly tied to INC-NET-31044.
